'This was a single-center retrospective study'.
'28 patients were identified who met inclusion criteria and underwent esophageal pressure (Pes) monitoring'; 5 died within 48 h and were excluded from analysis, but all 28 had the balloon placed.
All 28 'underwent esophageal pressure (Pes) monitoring'; no placement failure is described. derived: true with the inference stated.

Monitoring was started in 'patients who developed ARDS and had worsening oxygenation ... despite lung protective ventilation'; the anchor is ARDS (with hours null), as the codebook codes a phrase-only anchor. The interval is not reported, so timing_subgroup stays unclear either way.

Optimal PEEP was set from end-expiratory Pes, but the paper never states the numeric end-expiratory Ptp target (the −2 to +2 range is EPVent-2 background), so the strategy is unknown: 'unclear', not 'other' (a known strategy outside the list).
